scalars.scalar_value: 5+ years of specialized experience in healthcare data science or biomedical informatics, with a proven track record of applying advanced statistical modeling, modern machine learning, and production-grade agentic AI architectures to solve complex clinical, operational, and research challenges.

items.item_text: 5+ years of specialized experience in healthcare data science or biomedical informatics, with a proven track record of applying advanced statistical modeling, modern machine learning, and production-grade agentic AI architectures to solve complex clinical, operational, and research challenges.

Hands-on experience architecting and integrating data pipelines with clinical exchange standards and protocols, including HL7 FHIR APIs, USCDI, and medical terminology ontologies coupled with deep proficiency across both relational and non-relational database management systems.

Extensive practical experience architecting and executing solutions across unified analytics and cloud data platforms, electronic health record (EHR) data environments, and enterprise business intelligence frameworks.

Practical experience architecting and managing end-to-end ML Ops / LLM Ops pipelines, including automated model packaging, CI/CD deployment automation, feature stores, experiment tracking, automated model governance, and telemetry monitoring (e.g., data drift, concept drift, system latency) in regulated environments.

Experience designing and delivering interactive workshops, and educational programs on data science, machine learning, and generative AI methodologies to upskill technical staff, researchers, and clinical stakeholders.
Experience representing an organization in institutional, national, or international technical forums, conferences, committees, or research collaborations.

Demonstrated success partnering directly with physicians, nurse informaticists, clinical operational leaders, and healthcare executive sponsors to translate unstructured clinical documentation, electronic health record (EHR) workflows, and patient care pathways into actionable, high-impact AI/ML deliverables.
